NONE: › abbreviation for "répondez s’il vous plaît", French for "please reply"; used at the end of a written invitation to mean that you should let the people who invited you know whether or not you are coming
（請柬用語）敬請賜複（法語répondez s’il vous plaît的縮寫）
› to answer an invitation saying whether or not you will attend
回覆請柬，確認是否參加

example: I got a party invitation in the post, and I called to RSVP.
我收到一封聚會邀請信，已經打電話確認會參加了。
